summary: Backend-only Layer1 validation completed (DOCX/PDF/OCR/reprocess guardrails). 11/12 pytest tests passed. Read-only extraction over all 34 originals succeeded with 29 readable, 5 unreadable, 0 OCR-failed pages.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Layer1 dry-run evidence confirms summary: readable=29, unreadable=5, auto_classified=0, errors=0. Main failing regression is DOCX AlternateContent text loss. Existing upload/review suites were not run in this pass because request scope is Layer1 parser and those suites may mutate candidate data.
rca of the issue: Root cause: in docx_extraction._story_text, AlternateContent branch selection uses any(child.iter(W + 't')). lxml Element truthiness is based on child count, so leaf <w:t> elements evaluate falsy; any(...) returns False and selected becomes None. Result: AlternateContent subtree is skipped entirely. Reproduction: run pytest test_docx_alternatecontent_choice_only_and_deleted_text_ignored; observed output excludes ALT_CHOICE. Mitigation: select branch via explicit existence check (e.g., next(child.iter(W+'t'), None) is not None) and keep single-branch traversal to avoid duplication.
